zh: 在这个小区，晚上十点以后不能放音乐。
old_en: In this neighborhood, you must not play music after ten o'clock at night.
new_en: No music after ten at night in this neighborhood.

zh: 小区规定晚上十点后不能放音乐。
old_en: The neighborhood rules state that after ten o'clock at night, you must not play music.
new_en: No music after ten at night in the neighborhood.

zh: 我们上班必须穿正装。
old_en: At work, you must wear formal attire.
new_en: Wear formal clothes at work.

zh: 上班的时候你必须穿正装，不能穿运动鞋。
old_en: At work, you must wear formal attire and not wear sports shoes.
new_en: Wear formal clothes and no sports shoes at work.

zh: 在图书馆里应该保持安静。
old_en: In the library, you should keep quiet.
new_en: Be quiet in the library.

zh: 图书馆里大家应该安静一点。
old_en: In the library, everyone should be a bit quieter.
new_en: Everyone should be quieter in the library.

zh: 坐飞机不能带超过一百毫升的液体。
old_en: You must not bring more than 100 milliliters of liquid on the plane.
new_en: You can't bring more than 100 milliliters of liquid on the plane.

zh: 孩子睡前应该刷牙。
old_en: Before bedtime, kids should brush their teeth and not eat sweets.
new_en: Kids should brush their teeth before bedtime.

zh: 小孩子睡觉前应该刷牙，少吃糖。
old_en: Before bedtime, kids should brush their teeth and eat less sugar.
new_en: Kids should brush their teeth and eat less sugar before bedtime.

zh: 会议室里不能吃东西。
old_en: In the meeting room, no food is allowed to be eaten.
new_en: No eating in the meeting room.

zh: 开会的时候会议室里不能吃东西。
old_en: During the meeting, no food is allowed to be eaten in the meeting room.
new_en: No eating in the meeting room during the meeting.

zh: 员工得在周五前交报告。
old_en: Employees must submit their reports before Friday.
new_en: Employees need to submit their reports by Friday.

zh: 所有员工必须在周五前交报告。
old_en: All employees must submit their reports before Friday.
new_en: All employees must submit their reports by Friday.

zh: 博物馆里不能开闪光灯。
old_en: You must not use flash when visiting the museum.
new_en: No flash photos allowed in the museum.

zh: 上飞机不能带液体，要提前托运。
old_en: You must pack liquids separately; they're not allowed in carry-on.
new_en: Liquids aren't allowed on the plane, so pack them in checked luggage.

zh: 病人必须按时吃药。
old_en: The patient must take the medicine on time.
new_en: The patient must take the medicine on time.

zh: 你这种病必须每天按时吃药。
old_en: You must take this medicine on time every day.
new_en: You must take this medicine every day on time.

zh: 这里不允许停车。
old_en: You must not park here.
new_en: You must not park here.

zh: 这条路两边不允许停车。
old_en: You must not park on both sides of this road.
new_en: You must not park on both sides of this road.

zh: 参观博物馆时不能开闪光灯拍照。
old_en: You must not use flash when taking photos in the museum.
new_en: No flash photos are allowed when visiting the museum.
